notes.title: It's our four-year anniversary, and you get the presents! 🎁
notes.content:
Celebrate the fourth anniversary of The Game of Life 2 with us! 🎂

It’s been an incredible journey with 10 fantastic Worlds, 6 platforms and countless memorable moments. Thanks for being part of this adventure!

[h2]Join the Celebration[/h2]

Head to our website for a week-long birthday bash filled with daily challenges. We have a puzzle, and we need your help to complete it!

1️⃣ Each day, guess the Worlds, identify cool vehicles, solve fun puzzles, unlock special moments from the past four years and piece together an awesome Game of Life path image. 

2️⃣ Complete the puzzle to become a Life Expert and show off your knowledge.

3️⃣ Subscribe to our newsletter for a chance to win [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461050/The_Game_of_Life_2__The_Ultimate_Life_Collection/?snr=1_5_9__405]The Ultimate Life Collection [/url]for you and three friends!

4️⃣ Plus, for a limited time only, enjoy a big[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/33373301/view/4175480871057131602] 60% discount on everything[/url][/b] during the event. 🥳

Let’s party! [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/the-game-of-life-2-4th-birthday/#]Visit our website[/url] now and join the fun! 🎉

notes.title: Meet the Dynamic Duo: Super Hamster and Captain Squirrel!
notes.content:
You already know Melodia, Chronos, Titan and Rebel and they’re doing a great job protecting the city! [b]But here’s a little secret… They have help! [/b]

Alongside our legendary superheroes there’s [b]Super Hamster and Captain Squirrel! [/b]

Here’s what you need to know about them:

[h3][b]🐹 Super Hamster - Hamilton Whiskertail:[/b][/h3]

By day, a mild-mannered citizen; by night, the fearless Super Hamster! Armed with courage and the power to roll through the streets in a tight ball, Hamilton Whiskertail stands as the unwavering defender of all citizens. In epic showdowns, Super Hamster unleashes his signature move—the Hamster Hurricane! 

[h3][b]🐿️ Captain Squirrel - Sam Nutzington:[/b][/h3]

Meet Sam Nutzington, the agile Acorn Avenger, also known as Captain Squirrel! Quick-witted and nimble, Sam traverses the treetops with acrobatic finesse, leaping from branch to branch, and gathering intelligence for the dynamic duo.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/0eac790fb6c89266c854497fca3d7e5baf2ecfcb.png[/img]

[b]🦸‍♂️ Their Legendary Team-Up:[/b]
When danger looms, Super Hamster and Captain Squirrel join forces. Super Hamster rolls through the streets, embodying resilience, while Squirrelly Squire leaps through the treetops, gathering vital information. Together, they face many challenges!

[b]🌟 A Legacy of Courage:[/b]
Their tales inspire citizens of Superhero World to believe in the power of friendship and resilience. Super Hamster and Captain Squirrel's legacy lives on as a symbol of courage in the face of any obstacle.

[b]And hey, you also have a mission! You only have a few days left to vote on your favourite Superhero to inspire a new outfit FREE for all players! What are you waiting for? [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]Cast your vote here![/url] [/b]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/284716a952ac15b6378a4550d99c14b6f6eb4640.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet Titan and Rebel - our adventurous heroes!
notes.content:
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695460/The_Game_of_Life_2__Superhero_World/]Superhero World[/url] is out now, full of choices and possibilities,[b] and now it's your turn to influence its narrative! 🦸[/b]

Now that you’re familiar with Chronos and Melodia, (if you’re not, what are you waiting for to read our previous announcement?) it’s time for you to meet Titan and Rebel!

Don’t forget what’s your mission here! ➡️ [b]Vote for your favourite!⚡[/b]

[h3]The winner superhero will be featured as a free outfit FREE for all players! [/h3]

[b]The vote is happening [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]here[/url]! [/b]

[h3][b]Meet Titan - The Armored Guardian[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/0abc4ebdf03931c1f10a1d31a9fc05d3f75e66b5.png[/img]

They are strong and assertive, always focused on protecting the Superhero World from any danger. With their crazy wealth – earned through their smart investments – they've got access to top-notch materials, crafting the most powerful armour that the Superhero World has ever seen. Somehow, he keeps getting richer, and his armour keeps getting better!

But here's a hidden secret: Titan, this mighty defender, capable of making split-second choices in dangerous situations, struggles with the most trivial choices in their personal life. When picking between two flavours of ice cream or which movie to watch, they freeze. Literally. In battle, you can’t defeat them with strength, no matter how powerful you are.

But hey, everyone still loves them! How could you not? 

[h3][b]Meet Rebel - The Mindweaver[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/4db0c73f07070676bdb43fcd33606c2baed1c459.png[/img]

Rebel is the anti-norm superhero we never knew we needed. They don't play by the rules; they use the power of mind control to take on the world's injustices. They can sneak into people's minds and alter their actions, leaving those around them with a temporary altered judgement, thanks to the lingering effects of their controlling aura.

But here's the twist – every time they unleash their powers on others, they end up getting hit by their own actions. This self-inflicted mind-control messes with their own decision-making for a limited time, and suddenly, they're either on a winning streak or stuck in a streak of bad luck. This turns their interactions into a rollercoaster of unpredictability, making every outcome a spin of the wheel, whether it's incredibly lucky or just downright unfortunate! 

At the end of the day, they sacrifice themselves for the better of the Superhero World. What can be more heroic than that?!

[b]➡️ Now their fate is in your hands! If you want to have a FREE Titan or Rebel outfit, [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]vote [/url]for them now! [/b]

[i]Disclaimer: The following stories are created for storytelling purposes and do not reflect in-game content[/i]

notes.title: Meet Chronos and Melodia - our tenacious heroes!
notes.content:
Exciting news! With the launch of The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695460/The_Game_of_Life_2__Superhero_World/]Superhero World[/url] it's time for you to unleash your inner superhero and [b]vote for the hero you want to embody to conquer this amazing world[/b]. There are 4 incredible superheroes for you to choose from: Chronos, Melodia, Titan, and Rebel. [b]Your mission? Vote for your favourite!⚡[/b]

[h3]The winning superhero will become available for FREE to all players![/h3]

Have your say [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]here[/url]!

But first, meet your first two superheroes 🦸

[h3][b]Chronos - The Temporal Maestro[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/d003f4c5afd636177a2c921cdd1e40d4cc03584d.png[/img]

Chronos isn't just your regular superhero, they've got this rare gem on their forehead called Tick-Tock Crystal. This ancient stone not only makes them look legendary but also gives them the power to fly and control time and quantum woo. When it's time to fight, they tune their mind into the crystal's powers and can see the future, make smart moves and gain special knowledge.

But here's the twist – those visions? They're not always in sync with reality. As Chronos plays around with time, things get a bit goofy. The gap between what they see coming and what actually goes down leads to some seriously unexpected consequences!

[h3][b]Melodia - The Sound Enchantress[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/9e1f208ff19bd350e4684663da28a12436751be6.png[/img]

Melodia is basically on a mission to battling bad guys armed with nothing but kindness. With the power of positivity, they can craft melodies that make others suddenly want to break into a happy dance or become overly generous with gifts and assistance. Their vibes are so strong, even the toughest villains can't help but be enchanted by it!

But, here's the punchline— the powers are like a superhero one-hit wonder, catchy… but temporary. And to add a sprinkle of chaos, there's a cooldown period. During it, they can get a bit slow and might find themselves stuck in the less action-packed corners of the world for a while. It's like their powers need a little nap after all that positivity spreading. 

But hey, even in the midst of the chaos, our hero manages to bring a smile to everyone's face. Who knew fighting crime could be this groovy?


[b]➡️Now, their fate is in your hands! Do you want to play as the enchantress Melodia or the powerful Chronos? [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]Cast your vote now![/url][/b]

notes.title: Have a Fab-BOO-lous Halloween in the Haunted Hills World!
notes.content:
Gather your friends and family and celebrate Halloween like never before! With over 1 Million games played in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465431/The_Game_of_Life_2__Haunted_Hills_world/]Haunted Hills world[/url], it is THE destination for spooky fun 🎃👻. Will you become a Monster Herder, a Mad Scientist or a Werewolf Groomer? Will you get married in the Haunted Chapel, or stay single? Adopt a pet or have kids? The choices are all yours!

[h3][b]Your Avatar:[/b][/h3]

The most popular Avatar is the [b]Pumpkin[/b], but you can also choose the Bat, Ghost, Cauldron, Gargoyle or Scarecrow!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/b6fa0743d028dab11f2da13ac1b4de10637023c2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Your Costume:[/b][/h3]

The most popular outfit is the [b]Vampire[/b], but will you choose something different? Dress up as the Ghost, Mummy, Witch, Werewolf, or Frankenstein’s Monster and trick or treat your way through a life of magic and adventure!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/737f7b6daeafa2e77f550a059d72127b497e79fa.png[/img]

[h3][b]Your House:[/b][/h3]

The most popular house is the [b]Witch’s Hut[/b], but there are twelve to choose from! Will you buy a Haunted Dorm? A Haunted House? A Family Mausoleum? The Gravekeeper’s Shack? Or even the Ghost Ship? There is something for everyone on this frightful property market!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/57b63cd061f5ad6136b1e4066c5af65caa6647d8.png[/img]


Go trick-or-treating today! Join friends and family and play together, wherever you are. Will you find more treats on the risky road, or get tricked when playing it safe? The choices are all yours in this cosy Halloween adventure.
